Hi Susan — thanks for the details and the screenshot. Sorry you're blocked. I'm looping in Karthik from Ops and Evelyn from Partner Success so we can triage quickly.

Quick context: we ran a scheduled supplier metadata reconciliation last night to align legacy Zip->Coupa identifiers. There was a small subset where legacy email aliases and top-level tenant aliases didn't match exactly; those are the prime suspects for duplicate rows.

Action items we will take now:
- Karthik: can you pull the vendor export for Greenfield and confirm whether two vendor IDs were created during last night's job (attach CSV).
- Evelyn: please hold on re-sending any new portal invites until we confirm which vendor id is canonical.

Temporary workaround for Greenfield: if you can use the second invite link you received (it typically contains a token param), try login with an incognito window and request a password reset. If that fails, we'll do a manual merge on our side and send a single canonical invite.

I'll follow up by EOD with a concrete plan.

Best,

On Fri, May 22, 2026 at 10:03 AM Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick context: we ran a scheduled supplier metadata reconciliation last night...

Hi all — I pulled the export and attached the vendor-account-export.csv. Root cause: during the Zip->Coupa ID reconciliation the alias normalization strippped a trailing org suffix from one of Greenfield's records (origin email: accounts+gf@greenfieldfoods.com) which meant:

1) Two vendor rows were created (vendor_id 46721 and vendor_id 46798) because the reconciliation compares normalized alias fields and falls back to company name otherwise.
2) The older vendor row (46721) still had the completed onboarding state, but the new vendor row (46798) is the one that got the freshly sent invite token. The portal expects the token->vendor row to match.

Fix performed:
- I marked vendor_id 46798 as a duplicate and merged the token record into 46721.
- Cleared the stale invite tokens for 46798 and reissued a single invite for 46721.

Notes / follow-ups:
- Evelyn, please confirm whether we should proactively revoke the stale tokens across other vendors (I can run a script).
- Susan, you should receive a fresh invite email for vendor ID 46721 within 15 minutes. If you still see an error, reply with a screenshot and I'll escalate to Coupa support.

Attachment: vendor-account-export.csv

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Platform Operations — Redwood Inference
